name: 08_人工审核中心

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  topic,
  title,
  status,
  video_path,
  cover_path,
  voice_path,
  review_token,
  review_status,
  review_note,
  reviewed_at,
  approved_at,
  rejected_at,
  updated_at,
  created_at,
  render_started_at,
  render_finished_at,
  audio_started_at,
  audio_finished_at,
  media_started_at,
  media_finished_at,
  error,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    COALESCE(render_finished_at::timestamptz, media_finished_at::timestamptz, audio_finished_at::timestamptz, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    - COALESCE(render_started_at::timestamptz, audio_started_at::timestamptz, media_started_at::timestamptz, updated_at, created_at)
  )) AS elapsed_seconds,
  COALESCE(reviewed_at, render_finished_at, media_finished_at, updated_at, created_at) AS review_display_at
FROM video_topics
WHERE status IN (
  'SCRIPT_READY',
  'MEDIA_READY',
  'GENERATING_AUDIO',
  'AUDIO_READY',
  'GENERATING_COVER',
  'COVER_READY',
  'RENDERING_VIDEO',
  'NEED_REVIEW',
  'APPROVED',
  'REJECTED',
  'FAILED',
  'RENDER_FAILED'
)
ORDER BY COALESCE(reviewed_at, render_finished_at, media_finished_at, updated_at, created_at) DESC;

-- n8n Postgres node: Execute Query
-- Query parameters:
-- $1 = next_status        APPROVED, REJECTED, NEED_REVIEW, MEDIA_READY, or AUDIO_READY
-- $2 = review_status      APPROVED, REJECTED, NEED_REVIEW, RERENDER_REQUESTED, or VIDEO_RERENDER_REQUESTED
-- $3 = review_note        optional, may be empty string
-- $4 = action_source      e.g. review_center
-- $5 = task_id
-- $6 = review_token
-- This query always returns one row, even if the update is blocked.
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE video_topics
  SET
    status = $1,
    review_status = $2,
    review_note = NULLIF($3, ''),
    review_action_source = $4,
    reviewed_at = CASE WHEN $1 IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN now() ELSE reviewed_at END,
    approved_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'APPROVED' THEN now() WHEN $1 IN ('NEED_REVIEW', 'MEDIA_READY', 'AUDIO_READY') THEN NULL ELSE approved_at END,
    rejected_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'REJECTED' THEN now() WHEN $1 IN ('NEED_REVIEW', 'MEDIA_READY', 'AUDIO_READY') THEN NULL ELSE rejected_at END,
    render_started_at = CASE WHEN $1 IN ('MEDIA_READY', 'AUDIO_READY') THEN NULL ELSE render_started_at END,
    render_finished_at = CASE WHEN $1 IN ('MEDIA_READY', 'AUDIO_READY') THEN NULL ELSE render_finished_at END,
    media_started_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'MEDIA_READY' THEN NULL ELSE media_started_at END,
    media_finished_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'MEDIA_READY' THEN NULL ELSE media_finished_at END,
    audio_started_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'MEDIA_READY' THEN NULL ELSE audio_started_at END,
    audio_finished_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'MEDIA_READY' THEN NULL ELSE audio_finished_at END,
    error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $5
    AND review_token = $6
    AND (
      ($1 IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND status = 'NEED_REVIEW')
      OR ($1 = 'NEED_REVIEW' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
      OR ($1 = 'MEDIA_READY' AND status = 'REJECTED')
      OR ($1 = 'AUDIO_READY' AND status = 'REJECTED')
    )
  RETURNING
    true AS success,
    'UPDATED'::text AS result_code,
    id,
    title,
    status,
    review_status,
    review_note,
    video_path,
    cover_path,
    review_token,
    reviewed_at,
    approved_at,
    rejected_at
), existing AS (
  SELECT
    false AS success,
    CASE
      WHEN id IS NULL THEN 'INVALID_TASK_OR_TOKEN'
      WHEN $1 IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND status <> 'NEED_REVIEW' THEN 'INVALID_SOURCE_STATUS'
      WHEN $1 = 'NEED_REVIEW' AND status NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN 'INVALID_SOURCE_STATUS'
      WHEN $1 IN ('MEDIA_READY', 'AUDIO_READY') AND status <> 'REJECTED' THEN 'INVALID_SOURCE_STATUS'
      ELSE 'NOT_UPDATED'
    END::text AS result_code,
    id,
    title,
    status,
    review_status,
    review_note,
    video_path,
    cover_path,
    review_token,
    reviewed_at,
    approved_at,
    rejected_at
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE id = $5
    AND review_token = $6
)
SELECT * FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM existing WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  false AS success,
  'INVALID_TASK_OR_TOKEN'::text AS result_code,
  $5 AS id,
  NULL::text AS title,
  NULL::text AS status,
  NULL::text AS review_status,
  NULL::text AS review_note,
  NULL::text AS video_path,
  NULL::text AS cover_path,
  NULL::text AS review_token,
  NULL::timestamp AS reviewed_at,
  NULL::timestamp AS approved_at,
  NULL::timestamp AS rejected_at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing);

nodes.name: 说明 - 审核列表路径

parameters.content:
## 审核列表路径：浏览器审核中心

访问 `/webhook/video-review-list`。页面展示 `NEED_REVIEW`、`GENERATING`、`APPROVED`、`REJECTED`、`ALL`。视频预览通过 Remotion renderer 的 `/asset` 读取本地 `video_path`。生成中 Tab 会自动刷新进度。

nodes.name: 说明 - 审核动作路径

parameters.content:
## 审核动作路径：通过 / 拒绝 / 退回 / 重渲染

访问 `/webhook/video-review-action`，必须带 `task_id + review_token`。`approve` 把 `NEED_REVIEW` 改为 `APPROVED`；`reject` 改为 `REJECTED`；`back_review` 改回 `NEED_REVIEW`；`rerender` 改为 `MEDIA_READY + RERENDER_REQUESTED` 并触发 06 重生成语音/字幕+视频；`rerender_video_only` 改为 `AUDIO_READY + VIDEO_RERENDER_REQUESTED` 并触发 06 仅重新合成视频。

description: 第八阶段：人工审核中心。/webhook/video-review-list 展示审核列表；/webhook/video-review-action 处理通过、拒绝、退回和重新渲染，其中重新渲染会自动触发 06 的重渲染入口。
